'''Diyu''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Diyu system/Legends|Diyu system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']], which connected it to the [[Rorak system/Legends|Rorak system]] and the world of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], a [[clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], had influence on the planet.<ref name="LoNH" /> Diyu was a major industrial center that relied on [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. When the military forces of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] Hutt Space, Diyu escaped their advance.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Diyu was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" />
